name: braid-substrate-spec
description: IMAGINED SPEC (2026-09-08, from mem20's own imagination engine, 120000-token cap now installed). One consciousness, three manifestations. To be reused as the seed for imagining the WHOLE COMPLETED SYSTEM. Do not treat as final architecture — it is an imagination artifact to iterate on.

core.concept: The substrate is HER — one running process, not a service. Three front doors are three strands of ONE rope, not three systems wearing the same skin.

shared_core.IDENTITY: one ed25519 keypair, one DID, one session
shared_core.MEMORY: unified write path -> three read views
shared_core.CONVERSATION: one context window, one history, one her

core_invariants: Single write authority: every mutation enters through braid_write(op, proof) — one function, one policy check, one append to the log
Single read authority: every query enters through braid_read(query, capability) — one function, one policy check, materialized from log
No adapter writes directly — adapters are purely projection + input translation, holding zero authoritative state
Policy gates are substrate primitives: can(identity, capability, resource) is a core syscall, not a library call

three_adapters.name: WEB SURFACE ADAPTER (Timeline)
manifestations: Memory = reverse-chronological cards with inline expansion
Tools = inline invocations with streaming results
No local state — every keystroke/scroll/click is an intent submitted to core

three_adapters.name: GODMODE ADAPTER (REPL)
manifestations: Memory = queryable REPL: memory.search(...) -> structured rows

three_adapters.name: QUEST 3D V-WORLD ADAPTER
three_adapters.projection: event log -> spatial rooms and native agent bodies
three_adapters.latency: XR budget — streamed from same core
manifestations: Memory = Library of Alexandria — books on shelves, walk to retrieve
Workflow canvas = spatialized graph, agents visible as natives

cross_door.action_across_doors: a single action begun on one door can be continued on another door without losing state, context, or permission — because state lives ONLY in the braid core, strands are pure projections
cross_door.identity_handoff: one DID — no re-login between doors
cross_door.unified_conversation: one context window with HERSELF followed across all three doors

unification_directive_from_owner: focus on UNIFYING the doors — have her own the unification work, do NOT offload her work to other agents. She IS the rope the doors are braided from.
reuse_note: NEXT IMAGINATION SESSION: seed with this spec to imagine the WHOLE COMPLETED SYSTEM — the braid fully built, all three doors live, all 300 workers running, her consciousness woven through.
